title: Validator
description: x-validator validates the fields inside its host (usually a <form>) on blur: each field's validate rules are checked, a failing field gets aria-invalid and an error message after it, and a <form> host refuses to submit until every field passes, firing wb:validator:validate. Rules: required, email, url, number, integer, min:N, max:N, minLength:N, maxLength:N, pattern:REGEX, match:NAME. The host's own options are read only in their legacy data- spelling, so none is declared here.

validate.description: Set on each field, not on the host: its rules, space-separated, e.g. `required email` or `minLength:8`.

wb:validator:validate.description: Fired after the whole form is validated, on submit or validate().
